title: Prospective study to improve trial recruitment in oncology
summary: The aim of the study is to prospectively test various methods for improving trial recruitment in oncology.

interventions.name:
In a first step (TP-1), the various methodologies are discussed iteratively with the medical staff. Suitable methodologies are then selected and quantitatively evaluated in a subsequent step. Findings from a previous retrospective analysis are also taken into account.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Oncological diagnoses (e.g. AML, NSCLC, HNSCC, ovarian cancer, prostate cancer)
- Treatment, referral, or second-opinion requests to the CCCC
- Patients of all genders aged ≥ 18 years
Exclusion criteria:
- Minor patients (under 18 years of age)
